baseline.method: Independent DIPY 1.12.0 CSA on bound Stanford observations

relative_l2_definition: Euclidean error across every real SH coefficient divided by Euclidean reference norm; no alignment, scaling or clipping.
threshold_provenance: Fixed before local extraction: approximately eight float32 epsilons for the upstream float32 normalization stage; independently measured attenuation roundoff sensitivity is recorded in validation.md.
